exposure: gemeprost alone vs. mifepristone and gemeprost
cohort: 1814 women undergoing medical abortion at 13 0/7-23 6/7 weeks from January 2007 to December 2014 at a single centre in Italy
finding: There was no difference in the incidence of uterine rupture between women undergoing second-trimester medical abortion with gemeprost alone compared to those receiving mifepristone plus gemeprost.
